spec.title: Overall Avg Extraction Time
spec.description: Overall average (sum/count) per source

spec.title: Content Event Failures
spec.description: Number of content-module event failures within the dashboard's selected time range, by source. Counts every terminal failure on the content pipeline: extraction failures (graceful failures captured by the route's textTransformationFailed branch), infrastructure failures (ATS/SFS/ES exceptions after retries are exhausted), and unsupported transformations.

spec.title: Peak Extraction Time
spec.description: Slowest single extraction in the recent scrape window

spec.title: Phase Breakdown: Overall Avg
spec.description: Overall average split. If Transform >> Ingest, ATS is the bottleneck. If Ingest >> Transform, Elasticsearch is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Extraction Throughput (per sec)
spec.description: Extractions completing per second

spec.title: Total Extractions
spec.description: Total successful extractions since app start

spec.title: Metadata Lag
spec.description: Most recent indexing lag for the metadata module (gauge, seconds). 'Current' is the last observed value; 'Peak (2m)' is the highest value seen in the last 2 minutes. The line is hidden when there has been no activity in the last 2 minutes and no outstanding backlog, so an idle pipeline renders no series.

spec.expr: alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index", module="metadata"} * scalar(clamp_max((sum(rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="metadata"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="metadata"}) - sum(alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index", module="metadata", outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1))

max_over_time(alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index", module="metadata"}[2m]) * scalar(clamp_max((sum(rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="metadata"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="metadata"}) - sum(alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index", module="metadata", outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1))

max_over_time(alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index", module="content"}[2m]) * scalar(clamp_max((sum(rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="content"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="content"}) - sum(alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index", module="content", outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1))

The line is hidden when there has been no activity in the last 2 minutes and no outstanding backlog, so an idle pipeline renders no series.

max_over_time(alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index", module="path"}[2m]) * scalar(clamp_max((sum(rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="path"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index", module="path"}) - sum(alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index", module="path", outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1))

spec.title: Last Indexed
spec.description: Timestamp of the most recent document indexed, shown as relative time from now.

spec.title: Last Received
spec.description: Timestamp of the most recent document received, shown as relative time from now.
Shows whether the live-indexing service is currently running (ON) or stopped (OFF).

spec.title: Total Events Received (Live)
spec.description: Live-indexed events that entered the per-module routes. Aggregated across indexer pods with sum by (module). Reindex traffic is excluded.
Shows whether the re-indexing service is currently running (ON) or stopped (OFF).

spec.title: Live-Indexing Modules (split deployment)
spec.description: Per-module Prometheus 'up' status for the split live-indexing deployment (jobs live-indexing-metadata / -mediation / -path / -content). ON = the module's actuator endpoint was successfully scraped. OFF = scrape failed. N/A = no data yet (Prometheus has never reached the target — typical for a module not deployed in this environment).

spec.title: Extraction Percentiles (P50/P90/P99)
spec.description: Percentile distribution of total content extraction time (T6-T3). P99 spikes indicate occasional slow extractions affecting tail latency.

spec.title: Avg Extraction Time Per Document (by Phase)
spec.description: Average time per document for each extraction phase. Transform = ATS processing; Ingest = Elasticsearch write. Identifies which phase is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Total Indexing Delay
spec.description: Time from repository change to document searchable in Elasticsearch. This is the total delay a user experiences before new or updated content appears in search results.

spec.expr: max by (module) (alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) * on(module) group_left clamp_max((sum by(module) (rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) - sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation",outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1)

spec.title: Message Delivery Time
spec.description: Time for an event to travel from the repository (ActiveMQ) to the Search Enterprise connector. High values indicate message broker backlog or network latency.

spec.expr: max by (module) (alfresco_live_indexing_reception_lag_seconds{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) * on(module) group_left clamp_max((sum by(module) (rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) - sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation",outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1)

spec.title: Connector Processing Time
spec.description: Time spent inside the Search Enterprise connector (indexing, transformation, Elasticsearch write). Derived as Total Indexing Delay minus Message Delivery Time.

spec.expr: clamp_min(max by (module) (alfresco_live_indexing_lag_seconds{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) - max by (module) (alfresco_live_indexing_reception_lag_seconds{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}), 0) * on(module) group_left clamp_max((sum by(module) (rate(alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}[2m])) > bool 0) + ((sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_received_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation"}) - sum by(module) (alfresco_live_indexing_events_total{source="live-index",module!="mediation",outcome=~"success|failure"})) > bool 0), 1)

spec.title: Event Throughput
spec.description: Number of events consumed per second by each pipeline. A drop in throughput combined with rising lag indicates the connector is saturated or MQ is throttling.

spec.title: Total Successful Indexed Events (Live)
spec.description: Live-indexed events that finished successfully (after any retries). Aggregated across indexer pods with sum by (module). Reindex traffic is excluded.

spec.title: Total Failed Events (Live)
spec.description: Cumulative count of live-indexed events that reached a terminal failure disposition, by module. Includes graceful extraction failures (e.g. corrupt or password-protected files), unsupported transformations (mime types ATS cannot handle), and infrastructure failures after the recoverable-exception retry chain is exhausted. Aggregated across indexer pods with sum by (module). Reindex traffic is excluded.

spec.title: Success Events Rate (Live)
spec.description: Rolling rate of successfully indexed live events per module. Aggregated across indexer instances with sum by (module) so a multi-pod deployment renders one line per module.

spec.title: Failure Events Rate (Live)
spec.description: Rolling rate of terminally failed live events per module. Should be flat at 0 in healthy state. Aggregated across indexer instances with sum by (module).

spec.title: Total Retries (selected range)
spec.description: Total retry attempts recorded across the dashboard's time range, by module (live-index only, mediation excluded). Sums across both success and failure outcomes since they share the same retry mechanism. A high number here with a low Avg Retries per Event means a few unhealthy events absorbed a lot of redelivery work. Because infrastructureFailure.maxAttempts = -1 (unlimited), this number can grow large during a sustained ES / SFS / ATS / JMS outage without producing a single failure event.

spec.title: Avg Retries per Event
spec.description: Average number of retries each event needed before reaching a terminal disposition, per module (live-index only, mediation excluded). Computed as rate(retries_sum) / rate(retries_count) over the rate-interval window. The sum and count are taken across both success and failure outcomes so the result is a single, simple number per module. 0 = events go through cleanly on the first attempt; >0 = the route is exercising its recoverable-exception backoff (JMS / SFS / IO / ES). Note: infrastructureFailure.maxAttempts = -1 (unlimited) by default, so retries can stay elevated for a long time while a dependency is down.

spec.expr: sum by (module) (rate(alfresco_live_indexing_retries_sum{source="live-index", module!="mediation"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (module) (rate(alfresco_live_indexing_retries_count{source="live-index", module!="mediation"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)
